search_hosts: Find a host, tag, or note...
search_quick_connect_hint: Press Enter to connect to the first match.
form_section_metadata_desc: Optional labels and notes to organize and find hosts.
host_tags_hint: Press Enter or comma to add. Used for filtering on the hosts page.
host_notes_placeholder: e.g. Jump only during business hours. On-call: platform team.
empty_desc: Add a server to start establishing SSH connections.
group_empty_hint: Drop hosts here or add one to this group.
no_search_results: No hosts or groups match your search.
form_section_general_desc: Display name and icon shown in the host list and tabs.
form_section_connection_desc: Address and optional jump host for SSH.
form_section_authentication_desc: Credentials used when opening a terminal to this host.
form_section_terminal_desc: Optional passwords offered when the session asks for one (e.g. sudo).
identity_username_hint: Username and password are taken from the identity when connecting.
auto_password_identities_hint: Used to auto-fill password prompts in terminal sessions (e.g. sudo).
relay_host_hint: Optional jump host (bastion). SSH connects to the relay first, then to this server. One hop only.
forward_agent_hint: Expose your local SSH agent on the remote host (e.g. git clone or ssh from a jump host). Only enable on trusted servers.
relay_error_relay_self: A host cannot use itself as a relay.
relay_error_relay_localhost: Local shell cannot be used as a relay.
relay_error_relay_missing: Selected relay host was not found.
relay_error_relay_chain: The relay host already uses another relay. Only one hop is supported.
relay_error_relay_cycle: Relay chain would loop back to the same host.
startup_command_hint: Run after the shell starts (e.g. tmux attach)
split_with_local_hint: Local shell on the left, this host on the right
delete_desc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
delete_group_desc: Delete "{{name}}"? Hosts in this group will move to Uncategorized.
